subject: ADR-153: what the page hands over, and whether its own task reads it
body: ENTRY_REACH ASKS HOW MUCH OF A PAGE'S DATA ITS OWN TASK ENTERS. THIS ASKS THE OTHER HALF OF THE SAME SENTENCE: how much of what a page PRODUCES its own task READS. They are not the same question, and the gap between them is where a whole class of defect lives. Every figure this kit holds is read off the SCREEN. The file is built by different code -- a cell() that quotes commas, a Darwin Core row that maps a cover class to organismQuantity, an .eco line that writes cover x10 as integers -- and none of it had ever been looked at. THE SCREEN AND THE FILE CAN DISAGREE AND NOTHING WOULD SAY SO. ADR-152 made reading them possible and counted 80 buttons with one read; this measures it properly: 63 outputs across 19 pages actually hand something over, and 62 OF THEM LEFT WITH NOTHING READING THEM -- the exception being the deployment CSV written the day before. THE INSTRUMENT walks each page's states, replays its own task, presses every control whose NAME says it hands something over, and asks collect-output what came out: EMITS, SILENT, and of the emitting ones HELD (the task presses it AND then asks) or BLIND. FOUR DECISIONS CARRY IT. A candidate is NAMED, not proved -- a button is a candidate BEFORE it is pressed or there is no experiment -- and the rule is its label: copy, download, export, print, save, as WHOLE WORDS, because 'Preprint checklist' is not an export and matching inside a word is where a naive rule starts pressing things. 'FORGET THIS DEVICE'S COPY' IS NOT PRESSED: it matches copy, and the answer would be a lost autosave; the rule is not written twice but is harness_plugin_page.destroys, the same rule the gateway's own risk ladder raises DESTRUCTIVE on, and this audit refuses whatever that refuses. A PAGE WITH A TASK IS MEASURED WITH ITS OWN DATA IN IT, because an export pressed at rest hands over the placeholder a page shows when it has nothing to hand over -- '# log a deployment, the sheet builds itself' -- and that IS a payload, so the button would be recorded as emitting the empty page's bytes and never asked again. And HELD MEANS PRESSED *AND* READ: pressing an export is not reading it, which is the whole point, since the deployment log's Copy button was pressed by its own task for two ADRs before anything asked what came out. ONE PRESS EACH: an earlier draft asked a button again in every later state, on the theory that one behind a tab could not be pressed until its pane was open -- it can, because the plugin's own _reach opens the pane before it acts, which is why a task never has to, and with the ladder removed the kit's reading is identical to the digit, so it is gone. THREE SHEETS NOW READ WHAT THEY HAND OVER -- the collection sheet, the releve and the stand sheet, the pages where 'the file is the product' bites hardest, carrying 20 of the 63 between them. THE CLAIM IS AGREEMENT, NOT A SECOND DERIVATION: each new step asserts the export carries a figure the task ALREADY HOLDS ON SCREEN -- the releve's .eco must say Shannon H' 0.67, FQI 7.5, wetland prevalence index 4.77, the numbers ADR-149 pinned against the published methods, and its matrix must say WAS-12,62.5,0.5,3.0,15.0, the Braun-Blanquet midpoints the sheet shows -- and THE GENERATOR REFUSES any figure the task does not already hold, allowing only the export's own precision, because a cover of 15% on screen is 15.0 in a column written to one decimal and that is the same figure padded rather than a different one. Also held now: every one of those files' SCHEMA LINE, which is a promise to whoever reads the file and was checked by nothing; the two sheets' Print / save PDF, on panes their tasks had never opened; and the reference packs and the prompts they hand over. The kit goes 62 -> 42 unread and 1 -> 21 held, of 63 outputs on 19 pages. NINETEEN BUTTONS ARE SILENT -- pressed after the entry and nothing left the page -- and every one of them refuses honestly ('Nothing recorded', 'Nothing loaded') because the page's own task never records a session or loads a log: that is an entry-reach gap and not an export defect, and silent is not on the worklist, since a page with nothing to export is right to export nothing. verify_outputs 26, mutate_outputs 24 with 1 known equivalent. THE RATCHET is per page and downward: a page that grows an export no task looks at fails the day it does, with no flag, because run_all runs an audit with no arguments; an output that genuinely should not be read is declared with a REASON, and nothing is declared today. HELD: it measures REACH, not correctness -- a task that calls collect-output and asserts nothing about the payload would count as holding it, which is the same bargain entry_reach makes and is stated rather than hidden; 42 outputs on 16 pages are still unread, the instrument exists and the ceiling holds them, and extending the tasks is a worklist; a silent button is not a passing one, and the nineteen are on the same pages entry_reach already names, so closing that gap will turn some of them into findings here; and the candidate rule is a page's own vocabulary, so a button handing a file over under a name none of those five verbs covers is invisible to this audit -- the rule is in one place so it can be widened when one turns up.
